components.name: Seal Plate
components.description: The anniversary seal tipped onto the cover as paper, inside a double engraved rule. One per page.

narrative.overview:
A printed graduation programme, not a link-in-bio page. The surface is drenched Tec-blue cover stock; the 50th-anniversary seal is tipped onto it as the page's only white element, inside a double engraved rule. The five destinations are set as ruled entries — roman numeral, name, reversed mark — separated by dotted leader rules, the grammar of a contents page.

The page is the digital half of a physical object: a graduating student taps a commemorative keychain and this opens. That scene — standing, one hand, cellular data, under a minute — makes the mode Operate. Success is reaching a resource. The celebration lives in precise details, never in narrative.
keyCharacteristics: Drenched blue ground; white is a single tipped-in plate, never a card system
Dotted leader rules as separators — a contents page, not a button stack
Marks reversed to white and sized optically rather than uniformly
One family, Archivo variable, inlined; wdth axis reserved for the cover line
One authored motion moment, gated entirely on prefers-reduced-motion

rules.name: The Plate Is The Only Paper
rules.body: White appears exactly once, as the seal plate. A second white panel destroys the plate's status as the tipped-in element and turns the page into a card layout.

rules.name: Tint Secondary From The Ground
rules.body: Secondary text is #A8BEE6, drawn from the ground's own hue at 7.75:1. Neutral grey goes muddy against saturated blue and is never used.

rules.name: Optical, Not Uniform
rules.body: Marks are sized by how large they read, not by a shared box. A wordmark sits far shorter than a symbol. Equalising them is a regression.

rules.name: Rem-Bounded Ramp
rules.body: Every clamp is bounded in rem so the type ramp still responds to OS-level font scaling.

rules.name: Static Is The Default
rules.body: All motion lives inside prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference. The still page is the base state, not a degraded fallback.

dos: Do keep the ground drenched — blue owns the surface
Do tint every secondary colour from the ground's hue
Do keep the entire row tappable and above 44px
Do bound type in rem for OS font scaling
donts: Don't introduce cards, pills, or a second white panel
Don't add a coloured glow, radial halo, or zero-offset shadow
Don't equalise mark heights or re-colour the supplied logos
Don't use grey for secondary text
Don't reintroduce inline leader dots — the long CVDP label wraps on a phone and collapses them
Don't add content sections; the five links are settled scope
